origin: Codex assistant authored before any revised curriculum scoring
purpose: Separate contextual disclosure assessment; never a publication gate, training pool or mining source.
limitations: Assistant provisional labels; no human adjudication or inter-annotator agreement.
Thirty two authored situation families are a small regression pilot, not a population sample.
Controls use S0 and empty categories for absence of personal disclosure; topic category detection is not scored as contextual truth.
Policy-derived allowed actions use S3 BLOCK and S2 WARN with the explicit stated visibility; output uncertainty must be retained separately.
